comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This unisex armor, Armour of the Reconquista (translated from the above kanji; name in GAMA may differ slightly) is currently available from the Porter NPC in Seville (as you exit from the Church, head straight left and look for a seated male NPC).

Casting level 12 required. Ingredients:

10 Leather
20 Steel
30 Pure Iron Sheet (!)

Stat boosts are, if I'm reading the translation right:

+1 Swordplay
+1 First Aid

1500 total fame needed to equip. (Special thanks to Massena for showing the NPC with the recipe to a comp-mate, who in turn reported it to me.)
